profile.name: Teledyne LeCroy MAUI示波器
profile.description: 这是一类采用 MAUI 用户界面的中高端数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电信号波形。它通常用于电子、电路、通信和实验室测试中，对触发、时基、通道波形、数学运算和自动测量进行观察与分析。
profile.description_en: This is a family of medium- to high-end digital oscilloscopes using the MAUI user interface. It is used to acquire, display, and analyze electrical waveforms in electronics, circuits, communications, and laboratory testing, with support for triggering, timebase control, waveform viewing, math processing, and automated measurements.

registry.name: LeCroy MAUI Oscilloscope
registry.description: LeCroy MAUI Oscilloscope是由Teledyne LeCroy生产的表征设备，主要功能包括停止、扫频、测量、触发、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, absolute等操作。
